notes.source_scope: Only the assigned packet, brief, PREAMBLE, notation snapshot, and scan017 images were read. The note in C R10 about a following sheet was not used as ink evidence. No other reader or later page was inspected.
notes.workflow: Brief read first; current UTC start was then recorded before packet/image reading. Whole scan opened once for layout, half a once, half b once. Sixteen initial distinct tight crops, three later previously uncropped accent loci, and one final previously uncropped detached-mark locus were each displayed once. The final mark crop followed the initial source-only structural check. No successfully viewed image or decided target was reopened. No crop retry occurred.
notes.coordinates: Full scan is 1685x2363. Half a is 1685x1261 and starts at full y=0. Half b is 1685x1262; bottom alignment yields full y=half-b y+1101, using 2363-1262. Report full boxes use upper-left origin and [left,top,right,bottom]. Unrotated crop display coordinates use x_full=left+x_display*(right-left)/2600 and y_full=top+y_display*(bottom-top)/output_height. These maps locate hand-estimated graphical anchors. The rotated marginal crop was used for reading without a computed inverse rotation.
notes.graphics: G01 and G08 each contain two literal draw paths. G02,G03,G04,G07,G09,G10 each contain one. G11 contains two separate fill paths. G05 is represented once by a qualified prime/dot candidate, and G06 once by a qualified baseline point. Every insertion-guide path appearing in reading.tex has its own difference and inventory item. Local drawing origins, rectangles, coordinate units, baselines and zero-separation base-west text anchors are declared in TeX; font extents are not asserted to coincide with source boxes.
notes.crop_bounds: All intended target ascenders, descenders and guide endpoints are included. Some crops contain clipped unrelated adjacent-line context, including the neighboring mark at the margin-note crop boundary and preceding/following formula remnants; none is supplied as an extra manuscript word. No target was recropped.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No mathematical computation, morphism, theorem verification or algebraic correspondence was used. The written X minus Sigma_i is preserved. No mathematical repair was made. Bars, cup shapes, indices, circle/zero doubts and the literal transverse union stroke were selected from strokes only.
